title: Charles Nessler at the Schwarzkopf Institute for Hair Hygiene in Berlin
source: Das Haar. Blätter für Schwarzkopf-Haarpflege [Leaves for Schwarzkopf Hair Care], house publication of Hans Schwarzkopf, Berlin-Tempelhof, vol. 5, no. 3, cover page, March 1939. Source held as a privately preserved scan.
description: Cover page featuring a photograph of Charles Nessler during his visit to the Schwarzkopf Institute for Hair Hygiene in Berlin. The caption identifies him as the inventor of the permanent wave. The issue also refers to the hairdressing supplies exhibition at Zoo Berlin, held from 26 to 28 March 1939. The source documents Nessler's professional recognition late in his career. A handwritten marginal note is present but has not been fully deciphered. Document type: company magazine / house publication.
original_title: Charles Nessler im Schwarzkopf-Institut für Haarhygiene in Berlin

title: Gallia – General Catalogue and Price List No. 22
source: Gallia, Catalogue général et liste des prix no. 22 [General Catalogue and Price List No. 22], illustrated product catalogue with supplementary price lists and promotional letter. Société Gallia / Félix Boudou & Cie, Paris. Bibliothèques spécialisées et patrimoniales de la Ville de Paris, digitised collection, ARK pf0002154401. Publication date unverified.
description: Illustrated French general catalogue and price list No. 22 issued by Gallia. The 24-page digitised file contains catalogue spreads and supplementary sheets documenting a broad professional hairdressing and salon-equipment range: hair dryers and central drying installations; washing and antiseptic equipment; salon furniture and fittings; permanent-wave apparatus including Gallia-Boncelle and the Gallia Métro system; waving preparations, tools and accessories; barber and ladies' chairs, children's seats, advertising material and the Gallia-Journal. Supplementary sheets include detailed chair price lists and a promotional letter from Société Gallia / Félix Boudou & Cie. The cover states that this edition supersedes all earlier catalogues. Publication date has not been independently established. The catalogue is a primary source for the history of permanent-wave technology, salon equipment and commercial distribution.
original_title: Gallia. Catalogue général et liste des prix n° 22

title: Gallia Advertisement for Permanent-Wave Demonstrations in Budapest (1929)
source: Fodrász Újság, April 1929. Hungarian advertisement for Société Gallia, Félix Boudou et Cie. Electronic Periodicals Archive, Hungary.
description: Hungarian-language advertisement announcing lectures and demonstrations of Gallia permanent-wave machines in Budapest in the first half of April 1929. It refers to an instructor from the Gallia school, the export department director and a local contact at Rákóczi út 14. This is evidence of planned international promotion and training, not proof that the events took place.

description: French-language catalogue cover for Société Gallia (Félix Boudou & Cie), featuring a stylised hairstyle illustration, the GALLIA brand and the slogan 'La Marque de la Qualité' ('The Mark of Quality').
